items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Chris Kelly didn't have no brass band in the house. He had a jazz band. And you worked with him? Yeah. Played at the booths with him a lot of times.

ctx.x: Back to those brass bands here. Well, the Silverleaf brass band, they wouldn't really be playing too much music then, huh? No. Well. They'd be faking a lot of it, huh? Yeah.

Silverleaf had some good musicians. Tuxedo had some good musicians. Now, you take, well, we'd call them the Zulu band. They had a hot brass band, see? Black Benny, myself, Lewis, and what does Tramon play our name? Eddie Morris. Not Eddie Morris. Morris. Morris. Morris French. Morris French played Tramon with Rene. Yeah. And all them kind of fellas. Well, they wasn't reading, but part of the day, they come down the street and tear the street up. Who's this Black Benny you're talking about? Well, he been dead a…
Well, I'm telling you now, Rene, myself, Buddy Petit be somewhere, Chris Kelly be somewhere. And different bands, you know like that.
What about the white bands? Did they have white bands out there?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Chris Kelly was strictly a plunger man, you know.

ctx.x: Chris Kelly was strictly a plunger man, you know. Mm-hmm. And Sam just played a straight horn. I never heard him use no vibrato at all. Mm-hmm. Just played a straight horn.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Well, I won two Cups, one at the Espinade Hall down there, against Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Did you ever have any battles of music in the places like, say, the Bows Club or any of those?

Well, I won two Cups, one at the Espinade Hall down there, against Chris Kelly. What's that, the Italian Hall? The Italian Hall, yeah, that's what it was, the Italian Hall, and I won another at the St. Elizabeth, off a band called, well it was Earl Humphrey had the band then, that George Washington was playing, and it used to have two bands and everybody had a little dance at them times. Two bands, one this corner. Earl Humphrey had a band with George Washington?
Earl Humphrey had a band with who in it?
